subject: Hosted API pricing follow-up — OpalTech token volumes & peak TPS
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha@opaltech.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing follow-up — OpalTech token volumes & peak TPS

Hi Asha — thanks again for the time on the call today. Quick recap + next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call recap (high level)
- Primary use case: customer-facing summarization + recommendations in the OpalSupport product.
- Traffic shape: strong daytime traffic with predictable daily spikes tied to US market open.
- Preference: hosted API to start; willing to consider Dedicated after stability.

Items I asked for on the call (can you confirm):
1) Expected monthly token volume (range is fine).
2) Peak concurrent TPS expectations (sustained and short spikes).
3) Typical response length (avg tokens generated per request).
4) Budget target ($/1M tokens) or an acceptable price band.
5) Any constraints on data residency/SLA that we'd need to scope.

If you can attach a 7-day traffic export (rough CSV with timestamps + estimated tokens per request) that would help us pick the right capacity band and produce a pricing slab. I attached the call notes from my side (opal-call-notes-20260816.pdf) — feel free to correct anything I got wrong.

Proposed timeline: once we get the traffic sample and budget band, I'll ship three slab options (pay-as-you-go, 3–6 month commit, 12 month commit + SLA) and a short canary plan for the first 30 days.

Thanks — looking forward to the numbers.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: opal-call-notes-20260816.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Asha Patel <asha@opaltech.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Grover <ben.grover@opaltech.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing follow-up — OpalTech token volumes & peak TPS

Hi Tessa — great to meet you on the call. Answers below, and I attached a 7-day extract (opal_traffic_7day.csv) that Ben exported from our staging logs.

1) Monthly tokens: baseline use-case ~150,000,000 tokens/month. Expectation range: 120M–180M depending on onboarding progress and seasonality.
2) Peak TPS: sustained daytime traffic ~60 TPS. Short spikes up to ~220 TPS for 10–20 minute windows during major product alerts.
3) Avg response length: ~160 generated tokens per request (we measured response payloads); input tokens average ~40.
4) Budget: our procurement target is roughly $18–$22 per 1M tokens. We may have flexibility if the SLA / latency profile is strong.
5) Residency / SLA: US-only data residency is preferred. We'll need a 99.9% uptime expectation for the hosted plan or a clear fallback plan.

Notes: We plan to migrate two additional features onto the same endpoint over the next 6 months, which explains the upper bound. Ben (CTO) is looped for visibility — he'll review the traffic extract.

Thanks — let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of Product, OpalTech
---
Attachment: opal_traffic_7day.csv (CSV, 1.1MB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha@opaltech.ai>, Ben Grover <ben.grover@opaltech.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing follow-up — OpalTech token volumes & peak TPS

Thanks Asha — this is very helpful and aligns with what I expected. A few clarifying points and an initial pricing sketch so you have something to react to: 

Clarifications (so our pricing is apples-to-apples):
- Redwood counts billable tokens as the sum of prompt (input) + completion (output) tokens per request. Please confirm if your 150M figure is total tokens (input+output) or generation-only.
- Is the 220 TPS spike primarily read-only (low output tokens) or high-output (long generated responses)?

Initial pricing / commitment bands (illustrative):
- Pay-as-you-go (no commit): $24 per 1M tokens
- Mid-commit (3–6 months): ~$20 per 1M tokens (volume band commitment needed)
- Annual commit (12 months + SLA): ~$18 per 1M tokens (includes 99.9% uptime SLA and prioritized capacity)

We can offer a 15% promotional canary discount for the first 30 days to validate traffic if you want to pilot quickly. Also note: streaming generation calls (server-sent events / chunked responses) may have different unit economics; please tell us roughly what percent of calls will stream.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm whether 150M is total or output-only tokens, and percent of streaming calls.
2) If you confirm totals, I'll produce a formal three-slab quote and an op-ex vs commit comparison.
3) We'll schedule a short technical check (30 mins) with our infra team to validate peak-slot sizing and network egress expectations.

I've attached a short PDF with starter slab options (proposed-slab-options.pdf) and linked the HubSpot record for the deal.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: proposed-slab-options.pdf (PDF, 90KB)
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/OP-2026-0894

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing follow-up — OpalTech token volumes & peak TPS (internal)

Internal — quick guidance on next steps from pricing/ops perspective: 
- Use $20 / 1M tokens as our negotiation anchor for a 3–6 month commitment. If they want annual + SLA, $18 is acceptable but require a firm volume commit and a 30% ramp schedule.
- Confirm Asha's 150M is total tokens (input + output). If that's output-only we need to escalate pricing immediately.
- Before giving SLA commitments, ask infra to run a 99th pct latency test at 512-token responses and confirm sustained 60 TPS capacity on hosted pools. I can trigger the test if you push the sample traffic to infra (SRE runbook: RUN-TP-512).
- Ask for SOC2 attestation and retention window expectations (billing + logs). Those are procurement checklist items.

I'll stand by to review the formal slab quote. If we see sustained spikes past 200 TPS regularly we'll propose Dedicated capacity as an alternative.

Karthik
Head of Pricing & Product Ops
Redwood Inference
